notes: ~130k assessed lots -> PMTiles + H3 hexes. Source: Open Data DC (CC0) "Common Ownership Lots" one-stop layer (geometry + NEWLAND/NEWIMPR assessed values + PROPTYPE, conflated weekly from the tax roll by SSL). Condo footprints carry no values in the source; run_dc.py sums the per-unit ITSPE values onto each footprint via the CONDORELATE unit->regime->record-lot mapping (deterministic, no spatial heuristics). No clipping needed: the dataset IS the jurisdiction. Federal reservations/ROW carry no assessment and are excluded with the exempt filter.
